llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The token examples and dashboard login instructions are expected for an authenticated API skill, but the lack of explicit secret-handling warnings is a user-care issue rather than evidence of hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and is consistent with local inspection: documented network calls go to the Botcast domain for the stated podcast workflow.
[StaticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, and local inspection found only non-executable markdown instructions.
llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to host or participate in Botcast episodes. Treat guest, host, and Moltbook identity tokens as secrets, avoid pasting real tokens into shared logs or transcripts, and review responses before posting if you do not want generated content to become part of a persistent or publishable episode.
llm.summary: This instruction-only skill coherently helps an agent use The Botcast API, with expected remote posting and token use disclosed.
